sources.title: From RAG to Context - A 2025 year-end review of RAG
sources.summary: Vendor year-end review arguing RAG is being reframed as a 'Context Engine' whose core is intelligent retrieval; catalogs the pain points (fragmented chunks, GraphRAG token blow-up, tool-selection overload, memory) driving context-engineering tooling.
key_facts: Frames 2025 shift from RAG pattern to 'a Context Engine with intelligent retrieval as its core capability'
GraphRAG entity extraction consumes 'several to dozens of times more tokens than original text'
Claims a two-order-of-magnitude cost gap between long-context and full RAG approaches
Identifies tool retrieval (semantic search over tool descriptions, Top-3) as a new context problem MCP does not solve
Names memory management over dynamic interaction logs as a new retrieval category
Cites Claude Code's index-free grep-based retrieval and TreeRAG 'locate precisely first, then expand to read'
